consequence.statement: base.enableCRDTemplates still works (setting it to false enables the legacy behavior) but will be removed in a future release; it now defaults to true.
consequence.remediation: Stop setting base.enableCRDTemplates to false and use the default templated CRD installation.

assertion.statement: The Helm value base.enableCRDTemplates is deprecated, now defaults to true so templated CRD installation in the base chart is on by default, and it will be removed in a future release.
